verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَيُّوبُ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
verses.web: Then Job answered,
verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיֹּ֗וב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «صَحِيحٌ. قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ كَذَا، فَكَيْفَ يَتَبَرَّرُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ عِنْدَ ٱللهِ؟
verses.kjv: I know [it is] so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
verses.web: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
verses.he: אָ֭מְנָם יָדַ֣עְתִּי כִי־כֵ֑ן וּמַה־יִּצְדַּ֖ק אֱנֹ֣ושׁ עִם־אֵֽל׃

verses.ar: إِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يُحَاجَّهُ، لَا يُجِيبُهُ عَنْ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ أَلْفٍ.
verses.kjv: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
verses.web: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
verses.he: אִם־יַ֭חְפֹּץ לָרִ֣יב עִמֹּ֑ו לֹֽא־יַ֝עֲנֶ֗נּוּ אַחַ֥ת מִנִּי־אָֽלֶף׃

verses.ar: هُوَ حَكِيمُ ٱلْقَلْبِ وَشَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَّةِ. مَنْ تَصَلَّبَ عَلَيْهِ فَسَلِمَ؟
verses.kjv: [He is] wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened [himself] against him, and hath prospered?
verses.web: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
verses.he: חֲכַ֣ם לֵ֭בָב וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֑חַ מִֽי־הִקְשָׁ֥ה אֵ֝לָ֗יו וַיִּשְׁלָֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلْمُزَحْزِحُ ٱلْجِبَالَ وَلَا تَعْلَمُ، ٱلَّذِي يَقْلِبُهَا فِي غَضَبِهِ.
verses.kjv: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
verses.web: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
verses.he: הַמַּעְתִּ֣יק הָ֭רִים וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲפָכָ֣ם בְּאַפֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: ٱلْمُزَعْزِعُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنْ مَقَرِّهَا، فَتَتَزَلْزَلُ أَعْمِدَتُهَا.
verses.kjv: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
verses.web: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
verses.he: הַמַּרְגִּ֣יז אֶ֭רֶץ מִמְּקֹומָ֑הּ וְ֝עַמּוּדֶ֗יהָ יִתְפַלָּצֽוּן׃

verses.ar: ٱلْآمِرُ ٱلشَّمْسَ فَلَا تُشْرِقُ، وَيَخْتِمُ عَلَى ٱلنُّجُومِ.
verses.kjv: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
verses.web: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
verses.he: הָאֹמֵ֣ר לַ֭חֶרֶס וְלֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ח וּבְעַ֖ד כֹּוכָבִ֣ים יַחְתֹּֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلْبَاسِطُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَحْدَهُ، وَٱلْمَاشِي عَلَى أَعَالِي ٱلْبَحْرِ.
verses.kjv: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
verses.web: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
verses.he: נֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַ֣יִם לְבַדֹּ֑ו וְ֝דֹורֵ֗ךְ עַל־בָּ֥מֳתֵי יָֽם׃

verses.ar: صَانِعُ ٱلنَّعْشِ وَٱلْجَبَّارِ وَٱلثُّرَيَّا وَمَخَادِعِ ٱلْجَنُوبِ.
verses.kjv: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
verses.web: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
verses.he: עֹֽשֶׂה־עָ֭שׁ כְּסִ֥יל וְכִימָ֗ה וְחַדְרֵ֥י תֵמָֽן׃

verses.ar: فَاعِلُ عَظَائِمَ لَا تُفْحَصُ، وَعَجَائِبَ لَا تُعَدُّ.
verses.kjv: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
verses.web: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
verses.he: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלֹות עַד־אֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר וְנִפְלָאֹ֗ות עַד־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا يَمُرُّ عَلَيَّ وَلَا أَرَاهُ، وَيَجْتَازُ فَلَا أَشْعُرُ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see [him] not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
verses.web: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
verses.he: הֵ֤ן יַעֲבֹ֣ר עָ֭לַי וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝יַחֲלֹ֗ף וְֽלֹא־אָבִ֥ין לֹֽו׃

verses.ar: إِذَا خَطَفَ فَمَنْ يَرُدُّهُ؟ وَمَنْ يَقُولُ لَهُ: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ؟
verses.kjv: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.web: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.he: הֵ֣ן יַ֭חְתֹּף מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ מִֽי־יֹאמַ֥ר אֵ֝לָ֗יו מַֽה־תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃

verses.ar: ٱللهُ لَا يَرُدُّ غَضَبَهُ. يَنْحَنِي تَحْتَهُ أَعْوَانُ رَهَبَ.
verses.kjv: [If] God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
verses.web: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
verses.he: אֱ֭לֹוהַּ לֹא־יָשִׁ֣יב אַפֹּ֑ו *תַּחַתֹו (תַּחְתָּ֥יו) שָׁ֝חֲח֗וּ עֹ֣זְרֵי רָֽהַב׃

verses.ar: كَمْ بِٱلْأَقَلِّ أَنَا أُجَاوِبُهُ وَأَخْتَارُ كَلَامِي مَعَهُ؟
verses.kjv: How much less shall I answer him, [and] choose out my words [to reason] with him?
verses.web: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?
verses.he: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־אָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ אֶבְחֲרָ֖ה דְבָרַ֣י עִמֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي وَإِنْ تَبَرَّرْتُ لَا أُجَاوِبُ، بَلْ أَسْتَرْحِمُ دَيَّانِي.
verses.kjv: Whom, though I were righteous, [yet] would I not answer, [but] I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.web: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם־צָ֭דַקְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה לִ֝מְשֹׁפְטִ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃

verses.ar: لَوْ دَعَوْتُ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لِي، لَمَا آمَنْتُ بِأَنَّهُ سَمِعَ صَوْتِي.
verses.kjv: If I had called, and he had answered me; [yet] would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
verses.web: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
verses.he: אִם־קָרָ֥אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי לֹֽא־אַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּֽי־יַאֲזִ֥ין קֹולִֽי׃

verses.ar: ذَاكَ ٱلَّذِي يَسْحَقُنِي بِٱلْعَاصِفَةِ، وَيُكْثِرُ جُرُوحِي بِلَا سَبَبٍ.
verses.kjv: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
verses.web: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
verses.he: אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׂעָרָ֥ה יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְהִרְבָּ֖ה פְצָעַ֣י חִנָּֽם׃

verses.ar: لَا يَدَعُنِي آخُذُ نَفَسِي، وَلَكِنْ يُشْبِعُنِي مَرَائِرَ.
verses.kjv: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
verses.web: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
verses.he: לֹֽא־יִ֭תְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁ֣ב רוּחִ֑י כִּ֥י יַ֝שְׂבִּעַ֗נִי מַמְּרֹרִֽים׃

verses.ar: إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ جِهَةِ قُوَّةِ ٱلْقَوِيِّ، يَقُولُ: هَأَنَذَا. وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ جِهَةِ ٱلْقَضَاءِ يَقُولُ: مَنْ يُحَاكِمُنِي؟
verses.kjv: If [I speak] of strength, lo, [he is] strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time [to plead]?
verses.web: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
verses.he: אִם־לְכֹ֣חַ אַמִּ֣יץ הִנֵּ֑ה וְאִם־לְ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מִ֣י יֹועִידֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: إِنْ تَبَرَّرْتُ يَحْكُمُ عَلَيَّ فَمِي، وَإِنْ كُنْتُ كَامِلًا يَسْتَذْنِبُنِي.
verses.kjv: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: [if I say], I [am] perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
verses.web: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
verses.he: אִם־אֶ֭צְדָּק פִּ֣י יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי תָּֽם־אָ֝֗נִי וַֽיַּעְקְשֵֽׁנִי׃

verses.ar: «كَامِلٌ أَنَا. لَا أُبَالِي بِنَفْسِي. رَذَلْتُ حَيَاتِي.
verses.kjv: [Though] I [were] perfect, [yet] would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
verses.web: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
verses.he: תָּֽם־אָ֭נִי לֹֽא־אֵדַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶמְאַ֥ס חַיָּֽי׃

verses.ar: هِيَ وَاحِدَةٌ. لِذَلِكَ قُلْتُ: إِنَّ ٱلْكَامِلَ وَٱلشِّرِّيرَ هُوَ يُفْنِيهِمَا.
verses.kjv: This [is] one [thing], therefore I said [it], He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
verses.web: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
verses.he: אַחַ֗ת הִ֥יא עַל־כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֑רְתִּי תָּ֥ם וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע ה֣וּא מְכַלֶּֽה׃

verses.ar: إِذَا قَتَلَ ٱلسَّوْطُ بَغْتَةً، يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِتَجْرِبَةِ ٱلْأَبْرِيَاءِ.
verses.kjv: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
verses.web: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
verses.he: אִם־שֹׁ֭וט יָמִ֣ית פִּתְאֹ֑ם לְמַסַּ֖ת נְקִיִּ֣ם יִלְעָֽג׃

verses.ar: ٱلْأَرْضُ مُسَلَّمَةٌ لِيَدِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ. يُغَشِّي وُجُوهَ قُضَاتِهَا. وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ هُوَ، فَإِذًا مَنْ؟
verses.kjv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, [and] who [is] he?
verses.web: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
verses.he: אֶ֤רֶץ ׀ נִתְּנָ֬ה בְֽיַד־רָשָׁ֗ע פְּנֵֽי־שֹׁפְטֶ֥יהָ יְכַסֶּ֑ה אִם־לֹ֖א אֵפֹ֣וא מִי־הֽוּא׃

verses.ar: أَيَّامِي أَسْرَعُ مِنْ عَدَّاءٍ، تَفِرُّ وَلَا تَرَى خَيْرًا.
verses.kjv: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
verses.web: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.
verses.he: וְיָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי־רָ֑ץ בָּֽ֝רְח֗וּ לֹא־רָא֥וּ טֹובָֽה׃

verses.ar: تَمُرُّ مَعَ سُفُنِ ٱلْبَرْدِيِّ. كَنَسْرٍ يَنْقَضُّ إِلَى قَنَصِهِ.
verses.kjv: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle [that] hasteth to the prey.
verses.web: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
verses.he: חָ֭לְפוּ עִם־אֳנִיֹּ֣ות אֵבֶ֑ה כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר יָט֥וּשׂ עֲלֵי־אֹֽכֶל׃

verses.ar: إِنْ قُلْتُ: أَنْسَى كُرْبَتِي، أُطْلِقُ وَجْهِي وَأَتَبَلَّجُ،
verses.kjv: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort [myself:]
verses.web: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’
verses.he: אִם־אָ֭מְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָ֣ה שִׂיחִ֑י אֶעֶזְבָ֖ה פָנַ֣י וְאַבְלִֽיגָה׃

verses.ar: أَخَافُ مِنْ كُلِّ أَوْجَاعِي عَالِمًا أَنَّكَ لَا تُبَرِّئُنِي.
verses.kjv: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
verses.web: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.
verses.he: יָגֹ֥רְתִּי כָל־עַצְּבֹתָ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי־לֹ֥א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃

verses.ar: أَنَا مُسْتَذْنَبٌ، فَلِمَاذَا أَتْعَبُ عَبَثًا؟
verses.kjv: [If] I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
verses.web: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
verses.he: אָנֹכִ֥י אֶרְשָׁ֑ע לָמָּה־זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל אִיגָֽע׃

verses.ar: وَلَوِ ٱغْتَسَلْتُ فِي ٱلثَّلْجِ، وَنَظَّفْتُ يَدَيَّ بِٱلْإِشْنَانِ،
verses.kjv: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
verses.web: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
verses.he: אִם־הִתְרָחַ֥צְתִּי *בְמֹו (בְמֵי)־שָׁ֑לֶג וַ֝הֲזִכֹּ֗ותִי בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפָּֽי׃

verses.ar: فَإِنَّكَ فِي ٱلنَّقْعِ تَغْمِسُنِي حَتَّى تَكْرَهَنِي ثِيَابِي.
verses.kjv: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.web: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
verses.he: אָ֭ז בַּשַּׁ֣חַת תִּטְבְּלֵ֑נִי וְ֝תִֽעֲב֗וּנִי שַׂלְמֹותָֽי׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ هُوَ إِنْسَانًا مِثْلِي فَأُجَاوِبَهُ، فَنَأْتِي جَمِيعًا إِلَى ٱلْمُحَاكَمَةِ.
verses.kjv: For [he is] not a man, as I [am, that] I should answer him, [and] we should come together in judgment.
verses.web: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
verses.he: כִּי־לֹא־אִ֣ישׁ כָּמֹ֣נִי אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ נָבֹ֥וא יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

verses.ar: لَيْسَ بَيْنَنَا مُصَالِحٌ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى كِلَيْنَا.
verses.kjv: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, [that] might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.web: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
verses.he: לֹ֣א יֵשׁ־בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ מֹוכִ֑יחַ יָשֵׁ֖ת יָדֹ֣ו עַל־שְׁנֵֽינוּ׃

verses.ar: لِيَرْفَعْ عَنِّي عَصَاهُ وَلَا يَبْغَتْنِي رُعْبُهُ.
verses.kjv: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
verses.web: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
verses.he: יָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י שִׁבְטֹ֑ו וְ֝אֵמָתֹ֗ו אַֽל־תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃

verses.ar: إِذًا أَتَكَلَّمُ وَلَا أَخَافُهُ، لِأَنِّي لَسْتُ هَكَذَا عِنْدَ نَفْسِي.
verses.kjv: [Then] would I speak, and not fear him; but [it is] not so with me.
verses.web: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
verses.he: אַֽ֭דַבְּרָה וְלֹ֣א אִירָאֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־כֵ֥ן אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃
